decoderHint: Decode a clean, single-tone Morse recording offline. WAV: up to 120 seconds / 64 MB, mono or stereo PCM / float. Voice and overlapping stations are not supported. □ marks uncertain characters.
decoderThresholdHint: Raise the threshold to ignore noise; lower it for weaker signals. For single-length marks, set the known speed manually.
decoderAmbiguous: Speed is ambiguous because the marks have similar lengths. Set the known speed to distinguish dots from dashes.
decoderCaptureHint: Choose an input, then record. Stop to decode; recording stops automatically after 30 seconds. The temporary audio is deleted afterwards. Sound-card inputs appear here when Windows exposes them; this does not control a radio.
decoderNoDevice: No audio input found. Connect a microphone or enable an input in Windows.
decoderPermission: Microphone access was denied. Allow desktop microphone access in Windows privacy settings.
decoderCaptureError: Could not record. Check the selected input, Windows microphone permissions and whether another app is using it.
decoderWindowsCapture: Audio-input recording is currently available in the Windows version. WAV-file decoding works here.
decoderFileSize: Choose a WAV file smaller than 64 MB.
decoderFormat: Unsupported or damaged WAV. Use mono/stereo PCM (8/16/24/32-bit) or IEEE float (32/64-bit), 8–192 kHz.
decoderDuration: The recording exceeds 120 seconds. Trim it first.
decoderNoSignal: No audible signal found. Check the recording and input volume.
decoderNoTone: No clear Morse tone found between 200 and 2000 Hz. Try a clean, single-tone recording.
decoderNotMorse: The signal does not have recognisable Morse timing. Check the tone, threshold and speed.
